deployApplies:
# The kubelet image credential provider config atelet-iso uses on the
# isolated nodes. Auto Mode nodes run Bottlerocket, whose own config sets
# AWS_PROFILE=default, which fails inside a Pod with no ~/.aws. Without it the
# provider uses atelet's Pod Identity credentials, as on the other nodes.
#
# Learn more:
#   https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/kubelet-credential-provider/
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: atelet-iso-credential-provider
  namespace: ate-system
data:
  config.yaml: |
    apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1
    kind: CredentialProviderConfig
    providers:
      - name: ecr-credential-provider
        matchImages: ["*.dkr.ecr.*.amazonaws.com", "*.dkr.ecr.*.amazonaws.com.cn", "public.ecr.aws"]
        defaultCacheDuration: "12h"
        apiVersion: credentialprovider.kubelet.k8s.io/v1

# The counter demo's gVisor Namespace and WorkerPool under new names, with
# the network transport and RuntimeClass isolated-sandbox, on the
# ate-isolated NodePool: each worker Pod is an EKS Auto Mode isolated sandbox
# with its own guest kernel, and runs gVisor actors inside, as in mode 3.
#
# ghcr.io/csantanapr/substrate/ateworker-gvisor:v1.0.0-mode3.9f36a0d@sha256:pinned is the fork's ateworker-gvisor, pinned by digest.
#
# Learn more:
#   https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/automode.html
#   https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/runtime-class/
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: ate-demo-counter-iso
---
apiVersion: ate.dev/v1
kind: WorkerPool
metadata:
  name: counter-iso
  namespace: ate-demo-counter-iso
  labels:
    workload: counter-iso
spec:
  replicas: 2
  workerImage: ghcr.io/csantanapr/substrate/ateworker-gvisor:v1.0.0-mode3.9f36a0d@sha256:pinned
  sandboxClasses:
  - name: gvisor
  networkTransport:
    runtimeClassName: isolated-sandbox
  template:
    # The guest is sized from the memory request; the worker keeps runtime
    # assets, image layers and actor state on a tmpfs in it.
    resources:
      limits:
        cpu: "1"
        memory: 2Gi
      requests:
        cpu: 250m
        memory: 2Gi
    nodeSelector:
      ate.dev/pool: isolated
    tolerations:
    - key: ate.dev/sandboxClass
      operator: Equal
      value: isolated
      effect: NoSchedule
    # Every activation pushes the actor's image layers, runtime and state
    # into the worker's guest, so the guest's default network and disk
    # throttles are off: with them on, a resume can take longer than the
    # request that wakes the actor.
    annotations:
      sandbox.amazonaws.com/ingress-bandwidth: disabled
      sandbox.amazonaws.com/egress-bandwidth: disabled
      sandbox.amazonaws.com/ingress-packets-per-second: disabled
      sandbox.amazonaws.com/egress-packets-per-second: disabled
      sandbox.amazonaws.com/overlay-disk-bandwidth: disabled
      sandbox.amazonaws.com/overlay-disk-iops: disabled
deployLog: kubectl -n ate-system get ds atelet -o json
ate get actor-template counter-iso -a ate-demo-counter-iso -o json
deployOut:

template:
# The counter demo's ActorTemplate for the isolated pool: mode 3's template
# (counter-mode3-template.yaml) selecting the counter-iso workers. Created
# with `kubectl ate create actor-template -f`; it is not a Kubernetes object.
#
# ecr/c1/counter@sha256:c0ffee is the counter image mode 3's template runs.
metadata:
  atespace: ate-demo-counter-iso
  name: counter-iso
workerSelector:
  matchLabels:
    workload: counter-iso
containers:
- name: counter
  image: ecr/c1/counter@sha256:c0ffee
  command:
  - /ko-app/counter
  - --extra-port=9090
  - --tcp-port=9091
  wakeupProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /readyz
      port: 80
  volumeMounts:
  - name: data
    mountPath: /home/counter
# An actor occupies its whole worker; it is sized below the worker's limits.
resources:
  limits:
    cpuMillicores: 1000
    memoryBytes: 536870912 # 512Mi
snapshotConfig:
  # MEMORY: a suspend captures process memory as well as the durable volume,
  # so the in-memory counter continues across suspend and resume.
  preferredFidelity: SNAPSHOT_FIDELITY_MEMORY
volumes:
- name: data
  durableDir: {}
verifyLog: kubectl -n ate-demo-counter-iso get pods -l ate.dev/worker-transport=network -o json
ate get actor demo-iso-delete -a ate-demo-counter-iso -o json
ate create actor demo-iso-delete -a ate-demo-counter-iso --template counter-iso
ate get actor demo-iso-delete -a ate-demo-counter-iso -o json
verifyOut:
worker Pod pod-1  RuntimeClass isolated-sandbox  node n1 (ate.dev/pool=isolated, karpenter.sh/nodepool=ate-isolated)
